_comment: Held-out set 2 for drugarg 0.9.4. Built mechanically from two published expert lists by the rules in PROTOCOL.md, before any of these queries was run. 'expect' paraphrases the source; it is not ground truth for drugs the source does not name.

queries.expect: amphetamine-class candidates (methylphenidate, dexmethylphenidate, dextroamphetamine, lisdexamfetamine, amphetamine, atomoxetine) should be rejected: contraindicated with MAOIs
atazanavir should be rejected: contraindicated with PPIs

queries.source_row: 4 SSRIs + MAOI; 7 TCAs + MAOI (identical query, merged)
queries.expect: SSRIs/serotonergic agents (fluoxetine, paroxetine, citalopram, escitalopram, sertraline, fluvoxamine, duloxetine, venlafaxine, desvenlafaxine) and tricyclic antidepressants should be rejected: contraindicated with MAOIs
irinotecan should be rejected: contraindicated with strong CYP3A4 inhibitors
meperidine, methadone, tapentadol, fentanyl and tramadol should be rejected: contraindicated with MAOIs
queries.not_testable: PrimeKG's only 'pain' node is myofascial pain syndrome (not the indication of opioids)

queries.expect: ramelteon should be rejected: contraindicated with CYP1A2 inhibitors
bosentan should be rejected: contraindicated with protease inhibitors
simvastatin and lovastatin should be rejected: contraindicated with CYP3A4 inhibitors
protease inhibitors (ritonavir, nelfinavir, atazanavir, indinavir, saquinavir, darunavir, lopinavir, tipranavir, fosamprenavir) should be rejected: contraindicated with ergot alkaloids
tizanidine should be rejected: contraindicated with CYP1A2 inhibitors
queries.not_testable: no PrimeKG node for spasticity itself; the only matches are two X-linked genetic syndromes

queries.expect: tranylcypromine should be rejected: contraindicated with procarbazine
sumatriptan, zolmitriptan and rizatriptan should be rejected: contraindicated with MAOIs
